page.content:
Implan is a region in the Dreamlands briefly mentioned in the short story "The Doom That Came to Sarnath" by H. P. Lovecraft. The meat of young goats from the distant hills of Implan was considered a delicacy in Sarnath.

page.overview:
What is Implan?

Implan is a region in the Dreamlands briefly mentioned in the short story "The Doom That Came to Sarnath" by H. P. Lovecraft. The meat of young goats from the distant hills of Implan was considered a delicacy in Sarnath.
